theorem_title: Selected candidate indices reproduce the exact local schedule
formal_statement: theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.indices_map (h : ℕ) : (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.indices h).map (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.candidate h) = _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalHashMoments.localSchedule h := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For every natural local size $h$, mapping the finite selected-index list through its candidate decoder gives exactly the local hash schedule: $$\operatorname{map}(\operatorname{candidate}_h,\operatorname{indices}_h)=\operatorname{localSchedule}(h).$$

This list equality identifies the executed greedy candidate indices with the finite local schedule used by the semantic proof.
